title: Admit OpenModelDB as an optional specialized upscaling and restoration discovery provider under FA3 Model Manager
decisions: OpenModelDB is admitted as a specialized discovery, metadata and acquisition-source projection for upscaling and restoration models.
OpenModelDB does not become an architectural authority, canonical artifact identity authority, model router, runtime placement authority or artifact trust authority.
OpenModelDB catalog metadata is attributed source metadata and requires FA3 validation before canonicalization.
Provider-declared SHA-256 must match downloaded bytes; mismatch quarantines the artifact and blocks import.
A model license must be known before production promotion even where the upstream model license field is optional.
The GPL-3.0 license of the OpenModelDB catalog implementation is not inherited automatically by individual model artifacts.
PTH/PT and other dangerous serialization formats require Model Artifact Security scanning and explicit policy admission.
All OpenModelDB acquisition and import paths are mediated by FA3-MODEL-ARTIFACT-SECURITY-001; direct runtime-provider download bypass is forbidden.
Runtime compatibility remains UNKNOWN until executable evidence exists; catalog presence, checksum validity or metadata completeness is not runtime admission.
The existing FA3 Control Center Models & Providers view is the GUI projection; no parallel GUI authority or model manager is introduced.
